Got it—I will run R5's review on **Claude Code** as soon as R5 finishes.

**Why I didn't notice R5's stall before you asked:**
- **Timer hadn't fired yet:** R5 launched at `02:16Z` and I scheduled the 30-minute check at `02:17Z` (due at `02:47Z`); you checked at `02:39Z`, 8 minutes before it fired.
- **Real blind spot:** 30 minutes is too late to catch a turn-1 failure (Claude hit your 5-hour limit 20 seconds after launch), and because `kit.py launch` spawned `claude --bg` instead of an agy subagent, agy got no idle/exit wakeup when Claude stopped. Going forward I will add a 2-minute startup check whenever a `claude --bg` part launches so dead-on-arrival launches are caught immediately.

**R5 now:** the agy R5 subagent is actively running (updated R5's post to v8 at `02:42:53Z`).
